column2: the plan updates `reviewer-templates.md` and the plan-fidelity voter lens in `python/rendering.py`, but `python/cli.py render voter` still embeds `skills/shared/review-acceptance-rubric.md` verbatim before `voter_archetypes` (`python/rendering.py:1132-1147`). gate 4 can still instruct voters to default tests to out-of-scope after the lens override, so mini may resolve the embedded rubric over the archetype. regression tests that only assert archetype lens text (not full rendered stdout) would not catch a rubric revert or partial edit.

the issue acceptance criterion requires re-measuring plan-fidelity yes-rate on a labeled set of plan-mandated-deliverable findings (e.g. 36% → 20% regression). the plan's testing strategy stops at pytest, `generate check`, and manual prompt inspection, so shipped work cannot verify the stated success metric; prompt-string tests alone cannot prove the calibration fix landed.

the plan regenerates reviewer agent markdown but omits `python3 python/cli.py generate pre-rendered-reviewer-prompts`. `render_specialist_main()` prefers `agents/pre-rendered/*-body.txt` (e.g. `python/rendering.py:835-846`, `1873-1900`), so `/review` and `/implement` can keep serving old prompt text after template edits. `python3 python/cli.py generate check` will report `agents/pre-rendered` out of sync if body files and `.manifest` are not refreshed and committed.

the plan’s acceptance-criterion / testing-strategy replay cites `python3 python/cli.py render voter --archetype plan-fidelity-completeness` on a frozen ballot, but `render voter` only prints prompt text. it does not pass bounded plan context the way production dispatch does (`agent_voters.py` `_context_args` / `_make_voter_prompt_file`, `--plan-file`), does not invoke `agent dispatch-voters`, and does not produce `*-plan-fidelity-vote-output.txt` or yes/no tallies. an implementer can satisfy the plan by asserting prompt substrings in pytest while the stated ~36% → ~20% plan-fidelity yes-rate on the labeled plan-mandated-deliverable cohort stays unverified and citation-first behavior is not exercised end-to-end.

the plan adds gate-4 text telling voters to name or cite the exact plan requirement, but the plan-fidelity voter prompt already requires silent verification and output of vote lines only (`python/rendering.py` ~1176–1188). the plan-fidelity lens also treats citation as silent work. mini may emit ignored pre-vote citation prose, skip votes, or bury the plan line only in a no reason, undermining citation-first grounding.

the acceptance-criterion replay path does not enforce production parity for plan-fidelity slot v2, so before/after yes-rate deltas against historical `findings-classification.tsv` rows are unverifiable. gaps span: per-row `v2_tool` / availability-flag matching (codex vs cursor fallback when both flags are false); neutralized single-item ballot reconstruction from committed run artifacts (committed logs omit `ballot.txt`); and hard guards on voter-2 dispatch and parse success (`voter_2_status=skipped` or `failed`, empty or malformed `*-plan-fidelity-vote-output.txt`, or exit 0 with partial output) before counting yes/no or computing after-rate. replay can exercise a different prompt/model stack than the ~20% baseline cohort and record bogus pass/fail evidence.

calibration replay rebuilds each ballot from `round-<n>/findings.md`, but implement log flush excludes `findings.md` via `_round_artifact_deny_globs`, and many implement runs only ship `findings-classification.tsv` and run-root `review-findings-full.jsonl` (e.g. `larch-logs/implement/ce3f825c-e0c8-4ba9-8937-af2a0f1bdb2d/round-1/`, `larch-logs/implement/d2f1199b-06fc-43f2-9541-5d7ed9db1c75`). step 2 cannot build a neutralized single-item ballot and acceptance replay hard-fails or diverges from production ballot text.

the manifest and replay steps allow empty `fixture_plan` with fallback to committed `larch-logs/implement/<run_id>/` plan artifacts, but the repo ships zero `plan.txt` under implement run logs (and committed logs expose `plan-goals-test.md`, not production-shaped `plan.txt`). an implementer can leave `fixture_plan` empty expecting run-log discovery; replay cannot load valid plan context, `dispatch-voters` runs without the bounded plan the historical vote used, and before/after acceptance comparison is invalid.
